text:
anya: bringing up marigold-v1 (q8) on staging, seeing weird detok/translation shifts for mixed CJK + Hebrew locales. looks like zero-width chars are getting dropped or merged. anyone seen this after the latest quant kernel swap? :eyes:

samir: can you paste one minimal repro input + model output?

anya: yep — small sample below (i replaced real ZWSP/ZWJ with visible tokens for clarity):
```
SOURCE: 这是一个测试<ZWSP>שלום
GOLD: 这是 一个 测试<ZWSP> שלום
marigold-v1-q8 OUT: 这是一个测试שלום   <-- ZWSP removed, tokens merged
```

jin: hmm, that smells like normalization/codec change in the tokenizer pipeline after we swapped to the new int8 kernels. if the tokenizer strip step runs before KVCACHE segmentation we can lose the prefix boundaries.

morgan: can you dump tokenizer config from that staging container? quick check: are we running NFKC or simple NFC? also any ZWJ preservation flags?

anya: config excerpt (staging):
```
"normalization": "NFKC",
"preserve_zwj": false,
"token_merge_threshold": 0.65,
"vocab_version": "2026-02-18-compact"
```

samir: reproducible locally with the same quant artifact. ran eval-batch with 1k mixed zh-he dataset — saw BLEU drop ~0.8 vs float16 baseline. sample diffs point to zero-width removal + bracket mirroring in RTL segments.

eval-bot: Eval run 7210003250 finished: bilingual-detok-sanity-v2. Metrics: BLEU:-0.9, chrF:-1.2. Top regression tags: [ZWJ_REMOVAL, BRACKET_MIRROR_HE]. Full diff attached to run 7210003250 (link: https://redwood.internal/evals/7210003250)

jin: thanks. plan: 1) re-run tokenization with preserve_zwj=true and NFD to see if it matches baseline. 2) if that fixes it, add a compatibility flag in the tokenizer shim for q8 kernels. 3) run an automated bisect across quant kernels to find the offending kernel change.

morgan: quick workaround: enable preserve_zwj true in tokenizer on staging and shadow traffic to canary. also pin marigold-v1 to float16 for the next 24h for production routes hitting these locales.

anya: rolling preserve_zwj=true to staging now, will kick off eval rerun and post results.

samir: repro command if helpful:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"marigold-v1-q8","input":"这是一个测试\u200bשלום"}' https://staging-api.redwood.ai/generate | jq .output
```

jin: I'll start the kernel bisect job and link results here. tagging @morgan for the canary pin.

morgan: noted — opening track issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/ENGML-3147 (include sample + eval id). please add any additional failing inputs there. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: Scheduled rerun 7210003275 (preserve_zwj=true, normalization=NFD). Will post results when complete.

anya: thanks all — will follow up with before/after diffs once eval completes.
